out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment had not posted the permit to operate.
violations.corrective_action: At the request of the inspector. the CFM retrieved the permit from a back room and displayed it where it may be viewed by customers.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Observed unsuitable employee beverage containers (two bottles of water in the kitchen and one in the coffee prep station). Employee drinks with twist tops are not permitted.
violations.corrective_action: Employees complied with the inspectors request to discard the bottles of water. Employees and CFM were educated on the requirement for having drinks in the preparation areas.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed a kitchen staff member cracking raw eggs at the flattop with gloved hands. The employee then continued to handle clean equipment without removing the gloves and washing their hands.
violations.corrective_action: The staff members and the inspector discussed the need to prevent contamination from hands. Staff member removed their gloves and washed their hands at the request of the kitchen manager. CAFEIN (Inspection Date: 09/16/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed butterscotch cream with a discard date more than 7 days prior.
violations.corrective_action: CFM and inspector discussed the need for this time/temperature control for safety food item to be discarded within 7 days of preparation. This product has been discarded.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed sanitizing wet wipes and hand cream stored on the same shelf as food.
violations.corrective_action: Employee complied with the inspector’s request to remove these items from the kitchen.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed light fixtures in the kitchen and the storage room are missing protective shields.
violations.corrective_action: Install shields or shatter-proof light bulbs.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE DRINKING FROM OPEN CUP IN THE KITCHEN FOOD PREP AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO COVER CUP WITH LID DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at handwashing sink used by food employees: IN FRONT SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASH SINKS ARE PROVIDED WITH HAND WASHING SIGNAGE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION. CAFEIN (Inspection Date: 03/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean CAMBRO CONTAINERS AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS were stored DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR IN BACK STORAGE ROOM in a manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE UTENSILS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED COPY OF EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY TO PIC. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND HAVE EACH EMPLOYEE SIGN A COPY. MAINTAIN SIGNED COPIES ON SITE FOR REVIEW BY HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH HANDS AT THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO USE HANDWASH SINK ONLY FOR HAND WASHING.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED HAM AND CHEESE CROISSANT AT 66-68F IN DISPLAY UNIT IN FRONT SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' (TPHC) as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. MANAGEMENT INDICATED THEY WILL NOT USE TPHC PROCEDURES AND DISCONTINUE HAM & CHEESE CROISSANT AS THE MAIN MENU HAS “MADE TO ORDER” OPTION. PIC DISCARDED CROISSANTS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: CROISSANTS, AVOCADOS AND BEVERAGES STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN OFFICE/DRY STORAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: FRONT DISPLAY/SELF SERVICE WITH DESSERT CAKES AND IN TRUE 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE UNIT THERMOMETERS FOR UNITS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: TRUE 2 DOOR UNDER COUNTER (RIGHT) AT 46F/39F WITH EHS THERMOMETER - DOOR GASKET WORN AND DOES NOT ALLOW DOOR TO CLOSE PROPERLY; TRUE 2 DOOR UNDER COUNTER (LEFT) AT 45F/43F WITH EHS THERMOMETER - DOORS UNALIGNED AND DOES NOT CLOSE EASILY WITHOUT FORCE.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REPAIR AND EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED. DO NOT STORE MORE MILK AND MILK PRODUCTS IN UNITS WHICH WILL BE HELD FOR MORE THAN 4 HOURS UNTIL REPAIRED.
